user.description: If socket or serial communication is ready, press the local button to start. If IPARK Smart Home app is officially supported, additional features are provided through Smart Home integration. The new 'iPark Smarthome App' option works through the apartment complex's central server, the same way the official Android app does.

data_description.port: Port can be omitted for serial communication.

center.description: Please refer to the [documentation]({center_guide_url}) for instructions on configuring each section.

data_description.ip_address: Optional: only for legacy administrator floor/direction sensors. The new call buttons do not need this.

iparkapp.description: Pick your apartment complex. The list is fetched from the i-parklife.com directory. Choose 'Enter manually' if your complex is missing.

iparkapp_manual.description: Enter the central server details manually. IP is required; the rest are optional.

iparkapp_login.description: Enter the same username and password you use in the iPark Smarthome app. No token copy-paste needed.{report}

cloud_register.title: Register a cloud device
cloud_register.description: Open Settings → Mobile device registration → Register on your wallpad, then submit to request a code. If a response is lost, check the wallpad before explicitly submitting again. No UUID copy or Colab is needed.

cloud_verify.title: Verify the wallpad code
cloud_verify.description: Enter the six-digit code shown on your wallpad. For an expired code or an uncertain result, choose Request a new code. A new request is sent only when you submit the registration form again.

data.new_code: Request a new code (leave code empty)

cloud_finish.title: Retry login after verification
cloud_finish.description: Wallpad verification succeeded. Submit to retry login only; registration and verification will not be repeated.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration is allowed.

error.directory_lookup_failed: Could not look up the site directory.
error.cloud_auth_failed: Device authorization was rejected. Check wallpad registration.
error.cloud_network_error: The response could not be confirmed. The request may have completed; check the wallpad before retrying.
error.cloud_request_failed: The server rejected the request. Check the complex, building/unit and verification code.
error.cloud_invalid_response: The server returned an unexpected response.
error.cloud_invalid_code: The verification code must contain six digits.
error.cloud_invalid_complex: Select a complex from the list.
error.cloud_invalid_dong: Enter a building number without leading zeros.
error.cloud_invalid_ho: Enter a unit number using digits and hyphens, without leading zeros.
error.cloud_invalid_alias: Use 1–10 Korean/English letters, digits or supported punctuation, without spaces.

settings.title: Adjust User Options

report.title: Report a problem
report.description: Describe what is not working (you can also leave this empty and write it on GitHub). The next screen gives you a GitHub issue link carrying the BESTIN version, connection type, complex code and name, the last reply per device and recent errors. Passwords, IDs, IPs, coordinates, sessions and your unit number are hidden. BESTIN sends nothing: you review the text on GitHub and submit it yourself.
